training: Exactly one NER and one RE fit, each inheriting the frozen parent settings: seed20261008, 6epochs, batch2/4, lr2e-5, old08/old15 initialization. No hyperparameter search, retries, threshold search or candidate warm-start.
rowContract: Serialized row contractSha256 remains the RE parent hash; validate rows_for against reviewed receipts exactly, do not rewrite it as revision or experiment hash. Bind these other contracts separately.
baselinePolicy: Frozen35 abstract NER plus old15 RE is the prior abstract development baseline, not the production old08 NER. Re-infer all 4 old35/new42 NER x old15/new42 RE combinations on the same new 7 complete dev documents and 107 reference pairs. Additionally report the old08 initialization transfer NER baseline from the fit. Never reuse old 5-document pipeline scores or cached predictions.
labels: AI source judgments and same-session self-review, not independent gold. Previously exposed dev used for model selection; no claim of blind or final accuracy.
unknownPolicy: Mask UNRESOLVED entirely from RE loss and module score. Full pipeline only on complete documents including true zero-candidate documents; score all predicted pairs without reference-entity masking.
promotionGates: Inherit all parent NER promotionGates without relaxation. Compare candidate newNER/newRE to frozen35NER/old15RE on the same new full dev scope. Full EVAL support, not partial module support, controls pipeline readiness. Currently coverage7/19 and full EVAL0 already block promotion.
testPolicy: Do not read, label, tokenize or infer reserved or old test content. Binary integrity hashes allowed. No final-test lock or execution in this experiment.
deployment: No production inference, graph/database writes, service restart, automatic promotion or replacement. Preserve all historical snapshots/weights/scores.
checkpointPolicy: Save every strictly improved checkpoint in a new run, earliest tie; preserve failures. Preflight worst-case 6 checkpoints per model plus 1GB reserve; no deletion of user or historical assets.
